metadata.governingEquations: eta_t + ((h+eta)*w)_z = 0; (I - D) w_t = -w*w_z - g*eta_z; D(psi) = 1/3*h^2*psi_zz + slope_coeff*h*h_z*psi_z
metadata.operatorNote: slope_coeff=1.0 corresponds to the continuous operator solved by GPU Boussinesq.compute tridiagonal PCR. slope_coeff=0.5 corresponds to classical Peregrine (1967).
metadata.spatialDiscretizationNote: Interior spatial derivatives are 4th-order central difference; dispersion inversion (I-D) uses 2nd-order 3-point tridiagonal solve. Overall spatial scheme is 2nd-order accurate, not 4th-order.

initialSolitaryWave.formula: eta = a0 * sech^2(kappa0 * (z - z0)), w = c0 * eta / (h + eta)

flatBedVerification.description: With prominence threshold >= 0.005m, exactly 1 solitary wave is detected (height=0.1273m, retention=106% due to high-order nonlinear crest profile). Small background dispersion ripples (<0.002m) exist behind the pulse.

extendedShelfSolitonFission.observation: At t=14s on the shelf, an undular bore with a shoaled lead peak and trailing oscillations is present. As the wave propagates over distance on the shelf (t=26s, 32s), distinct rank-ordered solitary peaks emerge.

interModelComparison.description: Comparison of dispersion slope term coefficients: slope_coeff=1.0 (GPU continuous operator) vs slope_coeff=0.5 (classical Peregrine 1967).
